fato_historico: 1879: The locals of Knock, County Mayo, Ireland report their having seen an apparition of the Virgin Mary. The apparition is later named "Our Lady of Knock" and the spot transformed into a Catholic pilgrimage site.
energia_do_dia: Today carries a ethereal vibration, much like the quiet wonder felt by those who witnessed a sacred miracle in a small village long ago. You may feel a deep pull toward the spiritual realm. It is a good time to trust your intuition and look for signs of grace hidden within the ordinary moments of your busy daily life.
frase_do_dia: Where faith resides, miracles bloom like a field of lucky four-leaf clovers.
significado_numero: Represents the awakening of spiritual awareness and inner wisdom.
conselho: Consider visiting a place of quiet beauty to nurture your gentle soul today.
